description: The core board UI and data flow: the three data hooks with Realtime + deterministic fallback (fix #4), the weekly schedule grid + subject selection, the details panel, the right-hand sorted task list, officer task CRUD (Add/remove/status), and glow derivation + overdue flagging (fix #6 documentation). This is where acceptance criteria 2, 3, 5(partial), 6(partial), and 7 are realized in the UI. Depends on FEAT-001 (migration, types, sorting/derive, tokens, supabase client) and FEAT-002 (SessionProvider.role, mutations). Independent of FEAT-004 (theme UI).
steps: Create src/data/useSubjects.ts, useScheduleSlots.ts, useTasks.ts: each does an initial `select *` on mount UNCONDITIONALLY (no auth gate), subscribes to a postgres_changes Realtime channel, and reconciles into normalized state by id (INSERT append / UPDATE replace-by-id from new payload / DELETE filter-by-id from old payload). Each exposes { data, status:'loading'|'ready'|'error', retry }.

Apply fix #4 (deterministic Realtime fallback) in the hooks: accept a pollMs option; drive the poll fallback from VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK env flag AND/OR detecting the channel entering an errored/CLOSED/TIMED_OUT state (observable) — do NOT use a 'no events within N seconds' idle timer. Add an always-on reconciliation that refetches on window 'focus' and 'visibilitychange' so a missed event self-heals regardless of transport. When fallback is active, refetch every 15s.

Create src/components/ScheduleGrid.tsx + ScheduleCell.tsx: columns Mon–Fri (day 1..5), rows = time blocks derived from schedule_slots start/end. Each subject is a real <button> (ScheduleCell) showing name + room, keyboard focusable with a visible --focus-ring. Glow is DERIVED via subjectHasPending over the live tasks array (never stored): amber border + soft box-shadow halo using --accent/--accent-weak PLUS a ringed dot badge (--accent fill + 1px --dot-ring=--text ring) as the non-color pending cue. Clicking sets selectedSubjectId. Zero-slots empty state: 'No schedule yet — an officer can add subjects in Supabase'.

Add fix #6 documentation in ScheduleCell/derive comments: the glow halo (--accent-weak ~22% alpha) is COSMETIC, not an accessibility property; the ringed dot (--dot-ring=--text) carries the non-color pending cue, so no contrast check is required on --accent-weak.

Create src/components/DetailsPanel.tsx: for the selected subject, list ONLY that subject's PENDING tasks (title, note, date given, deadline), sorted via sorting.ts applied to pending-only. Overdue pending tasks (isOverdue, viewer-local date via localTodayISO) render with a --danger border/badge + --danger-contrast. Empty states: no selection -> no-selection message; selected subject with no pending tasks -> empty details. If the selected subject is deleted via Realtime, clear selection.

Create src/components/TaskList.tsx + TaskRow.tsx: the FULL class to-do list, each row 'Subject - Task' + date given + deadline, sorted nearest-deadline-first (nulls last) via sorting.ts over all tasks. Overdue rows flagged with --danger. Officers (role==='officer') see an 'Add task' button (opens AddTaskDialog) and a per-row remove button + status toggle; members AND anonymous users see NEITHER (and the DB rejects forged writes anyway). Zero-tasks empty state: 'No tasks yet.'

Create src/components/AddTaskDialog.tsx (officers): fields title (required, trimmed, 1–200), notes (optional, 0–2000), givenDate (defaults today), deadline (optional; if earlier than givenDate warn but allow). Submit calls mutations.addTask (no optimistic update; Realtime delivers the row). All controls real <button>/inputs with focus rings.

Create src/components/Layout.tsx holding selectedSubjectId state (passed to ScheduleGrid highlight + DetailsPanel filter) and the desktop CSS grid 70%/30% (left column stacks ScheduleGrid over DetailsPanel; right column is TaskList). Wire Header + dialogs. (Responsive/mobile stacking + full a11y pass is finalized in FEAT-005; basic desktop layout here must build and render.)

Add unit tests: sorting.ts (dated-before-undated, nearest-first, undated-last, stable tiebreak); derive.ts (subjectHasPending toggles; isOverdue same-day not overdue / one-day-past overdue / no-deadline never; localTodayISO zero-pads single-digit month+day e.g. new Date(2025,0,3) -> '2025-01-03' and matches local not UTC near midnight). Add RTL tests: ScheduleCell is a real <button>, focusable, shows the ringed dot when pending; officer-only TaskRow remove/status + Add-task trigger render for officer and are ABSENT for member and anon.
Commit locally on branch classboard via git -C c:\Users\paulc\Projects\ToDoS\.worktrees\classboard. Never push.
acceptance_criteria: Data hooks fetch unconditionally (anonymous read works); Realtime reconciles by id; the fallback is config/observable-state driven (NOT an idle timer) and focus/visibilitychange reconciliation is always on.
Adding a task flips subjectHasPending true -> the subject glows immediately for all connected clients incl. anonymous; removing/completing the last pending task stops the glow (criterion 2).
Clicking a subject shows only that subject's pending tasks + details (criterion 3).
The right-hand list is sorted nearest-deadline-first with null deadlines last; overdue pending tasks are flagged and stay visible until an officer removes/completes them.
Officer-only controls render for officers and are absent for members and anonymous users; the DB rejects forged writes regardless (criteria 1 + 7).
ScheduleCell, Add, remove, and status controls are real <button>s with visible focus (criterion 6).
Unit tests for sorting/derive and the RTL component tests pass; `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` all pass.
verification: npm run test -> sorting/derive unit tests and ScheduleCell/TaskRow RTL tests pass

Manual (documented in SETUP.md, optional live): with a live backend, an officer INSERT makes the subject glow for an anonymous viewer without reload; completing/removing the last pending task stops the glow
findings:
SHIPPED. Verified in worktree: npm run typecheck clean (0 errors); npm run lint = 0 errors (1 pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components WARNING on SessionProvider.tsx, carried from FEAT-002, lint exits 0); npm run test = 53 passed | 9 skipped (the 9 are the FEAT-002 RLS integration suite, skipped-with-reason, no live backend); npm run build OK (dist emitted, inline CBTheme bootstrap preserved in dist/index.html).

DATA HOOKS — shared engine. The three hooks (src/data/useSubjects.ts, useScheduleSlots.ts, useTasks.ts) each stay their own module per the component tree but delegate to a shared src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts<Row,Domain>(table, mapRow, pollMs=15000) that holds the fetch+reconcile+fallback logic in ONE place. Each hook supplies its row->domain mapper (subject_id->subjectId, given_date->givenDate, start_time->startTime, etc.) and exposes { data, status:'loading'|'ready'|'error', retry }. Initial `select *` runs on mount UNCONDITIONALLY (no session/auth gate — anon read). Realtime: supabase.channel(`public:<table>`).on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table},reconcile). Reconcile keys STRICTLY by id: INSERT appends (dedup-replaces if id already present from a concurrent refetch), UPDATE replaces-by-id from payload.new, DELETE filters-by-id from payload.old.id (only the PK is read off old, honoring the default-replica-identity contract).

FIX #4 (deterministic fallback) — implemented exactly as specified, NO idle timer. Poll fallback (every pollMs=15s) starts from: (a) config — realtimeFallback (VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK==='1', imported from lib/supabase) polls from the start; AND/OR (b) observable channel state — the .subscribe(status) callback starts polling when status is 'CHANNEL_ERROR' | 'TIMED_OUT' | 'CLOSED'. There is NO 'no events within N seconds' timer anywhere. Separately, an ALWAYS-ON self-heal refetches on window 'focus' and document 'visibilitychange'(->visible) regardless of transport/fallback. Cleanup clears the poll interval, removes both listeners, and client.removeChannel(channel). GOTCHA: `tsc -b` (build) is stricter than `tsc --noEmit` about null-narrowing across the effect-cleanup closure — captured `const client = supabase` right after the null guard and used `client` in channel/removeChannel so narrowing survives; typecheck passed but build failed TS18047 until this.

SCHEDULE GRID. src/components/ScheduleCell.tsx = a real <button> (aria-pressed=selected) showing name + room; glow DERIVED via a `pending` prop. Pending => amber border + box-shadow halo using --accent/--accent-weak (COSMETIC, fix #6 documented in the component header) PLUS a ringed dot badge (data-testid="pending-dot", --accent fill + 1px --dot-ring=--text ring) as the NON-COLOR cue, plus an .sr-only '(has pending tasks)' text. Added .sr-only to styles/base.css. src/components/ScheduleGrid.tsx: columns Mon-Fri (day 1..5), rows = DISTINCT time blocks derived from schedule_slots start/end (sorted lexicographically on 'HH:MM:SS'), each occupied (block,day) cell renders a ScheduleCell with pending=subjectHasPending(subject.id, tasks). Semantic <table> with scope headers; wrapped in overflow-x:auto. Zero-slots empty state: 'No schedule yet — an officer can add subjects in Supabase.' A subject with tasks but no slot has no cell (documented acceptable edge case) — it still appears in the right-hand list.

DETAILS PANEL. src/components/DetailsPanel.tsx: for the selected subject, lists ONLY its PENDING tasks sorted via sortByDeadline; overdue (isOverdue vs localTodayISO()) => --danger border + 'Overdue' badge (--danger/--danger-contrast). Empty states: no selection => prompt; selected w/ no pending => 'No pending tasks for this subject.' Selection-cleared-on-delete is handled in Layout (see below), with a defensive no-selection fallback here if the subject isn't in `subjects`.

TASK LIST / ROW. src/components/TaskList.tsx: FULL list sorted sortByDeadline over ALL tasks (nearest-first, nulls last). Officer (isOfficer from useSession) sees 'Add task' (opens AddTaskDialog in a fixed overlay) + per-row controls; members AND anon see NONE. No optimistic UI: setTaskStatus/removeTask run, success reconciles via Realtime, failure shows an inline role=alert MUTATION_MESSAGES line. Zero tasks => 'No tasks yet.' src/components/TaskRow.tsx: 'Subject - Task' + 'Given <date> · Due <date>'/'· No deadline'; overdue => --danger border + badge; officer-only 'Mark done'/'Reopen' toggle + 'Remove' (aria-label 'Remove <subject> - <title>'), both real <button>s.

ADD TASK DIALOG. src/components/AddTaskDialog.tsx (officer path): subject <select> (required; if subjects empty shows 'Add a subject in Supabase...' + Close), title (required, trimmed, 1-200, submit disabled while invalid), notes (0-2000 with live counter), givenDate (defaults localTodayISO()), deadline (optional; if < givenDate shows a role=status warning but STILL allows submit). Submit calls mutations.addTask({...,createdBy: profile?.id ?? null}); on ok closes (row arrives via Realtime), on error shows MUTATION_MESSAGES inline. All real inputs/select/buttons.

LAYOUT + WIRING. src/components/Layout.tsx owns selectedSubjectId, calls the three hooks, renders Header + a desktop CSS grid gridTemplateColumns:'70% 30%' (left column flex-stacks ScheduleGrid over DetailsPanel; right column TaskList). A useEffect clears selectedSubjectId when the selected subject leaves the live subjects array (Realtime delete). An error bar with a Retry (retries all three hooks) shows if any hook status==='error'. App.tsx now renders <SessionProvider><Layout/></SessionProvider> (removed the placeholder shell + standalone Header, which Layout now owns); FEAT-004 will insert <ThemeProvider> between them. Still renders <ConfigError/> when !isConfigured; data access remains un-gated on auth.

TESTS. sorting/derive UNIT tests already shipped in FEAT-001 (src/lib/sorting.test.ts, derive.test.ts) and ALREADY cover every FEAT-003-required case (dated-before-undated / nearest-first / undated-last / stable tiebreak givenDate then id; subjectHasPending toggles; isOverdue same-day not-overdue / one-day-past overdue / done-not-overdue / no-deadline never; localTodayISO zero-pads single-digit month+day new Date(2025,0,3)->'2025-01-03' and matches LOCAL not UTC near midnight) — not duplicated. NEW RTL tests: src/components/ScheduleCell.test.tsx (real <button> tagName + focusable; ringed pending-dot present only when pending; onSelect fires with id). src/components/TaskList.test.tsx (Add task + Remove + Mark done render for officer; ALL absent for member AND anon while the task text stays visible to everyone; 'No tasks yet.' empty state). MOCK PATTERN followed from FEAT-002 findings: useSession and ../data/mutations mocked via vi.hoisted() factories (no top-level closure capture).

MANUAL (not run here, no live backend): per FEAT-003 verification + SETUP.md, with a live project an officer INSERT makes the subject glow for an anonymous viewer without reload, and completing/removing the last pending task stops the glow; and if anon Realtime is flaky, VITE_REALTIME_FALLBACK=1 (or an errored/closed channel) switches to the 15s poll while focus/visibilitychange keeps it fresh.
